rust_summary: drawing a component-bearing item stack and its decorations on a screen (`native_item_stack`).
doc_summary: drawing an item stack on a screen: `native_item_stack(batch, stack, at, size)` draws its model, glint, damage bar, cooldown and mod decorations, but not its count. It returns false for an unknown item. Bundles need "hooks": @API:item_stack@.
